name: Colorful Rosette Fascinator
description: A bright and playful party mini hairpiece featuring a pink round base decorated with colorful rolled satin roses in orange, yellow, green, turquoise, purple, and pink. Each rose is detailed with a shiny crystal center, paired with a lively fan of matching rainbow feathers.
description2: It is lightweight, easy to clip into the hair, and brings a fun, festive touch to any celebration outfit. This piece can be customized in any color to match your dress.
